_readme: Every key here is a thing the checker would otherwise fail on. An
exemption is only allowed with a reason someone had to type: a silent
pass is what this whole layer exists to stop.
_status_note: The status vocabulary is a CLOSED SET defined once in
CONTRIBUTING.md#status-vocabulary. status_labels mirrors that set and the
checker asserts every label still appears in CONTRIBUTING.md, so this file
cannot quietly enforce a vocabulary nobody documented.
status_stems are the opening words a status may start with; the prose
after the stem is the qualifier and is free. Compound statuses joined with
' + ' are allowed and every part must open with a stem.

became 'measured here, raw not published' and 'contributor-measured,
conditions as reported' was added. This config is seeded from the tree at
_upstream_tier_note: The fourth tier, upstream-reported, lives in upstream/ and is enforced by
integrity/upstream_integrity.py. It is NOT part of status_labels above:
those are the labels valid on a registry entry under traps/, and
upstream-reported is deliberately not one of them. The two vocabularies
are separate because the directories are separate, which is the whole
reported_by_others_grandfathered is a SNAPSHOT, taken 2026-07-28, of every
entry under traps/ whose status opens with 'reported by others'. All of
them predate the tier. The check refuses any NEW one, so the easy path
for the next upstream-sourced report is upstream/ rather than traps/ with
the old label. Removing a file from this list is allowed (an entry that
gets reproduced here changes label); adding one is the thing being
prevented, and doing it by editing this file is at least a decision

changelog_batches.01-07: 2026-07-27 launch line: 'Launched with seven traps (reasoning fields, templates, thinking control, scorer normalization)'. Prose only, no ids in the line, so it cannot be parsed. Traps 01 to 07 are the launch set.

index_exempt.05: scorer normalization is a property of the scorer, not of any model or serving stack; it is listed under the eval-harness stack row, which the checker does see, and this key covers the case where that row is rewritten
index_exempt.11: listed on the Laguna family row; kept here as a note that speculative depth is a drafter property, not a model-family one
index_exempt.14: listed on the ~600B-class MoE row by description rather than by a model name, because the re-upload is a community artifact with no stable family label
index_exempt.31: leftover oracle re-ranker lives entirely in the harness; it appears on the eval-harness stack row and belongs to no model
index_exempt.32: mlx_lm server flag; appears on the mlx_lm stack row and on the Bonsai model row
index_exempt.40: n-gram decontamination is a corpus-screening step upstream of any model; eval-harness stack row only
